$comment: Keeps agents aware of the whole repo, not just root rules. UserPromptSubmit re-injects the context-map reminder every turn (harness-enforced, so it survives long sessions and context drift); SessionStart does it once on startup. Other agents rely on the 'Start here — context map' section in CLAUDE.md.

hooks.command: printf '%s' 'Reminder: CLAUDE.md is a ROUTER, not the whole spec. Before acting, load what your task maps to in its "Start here — context map": TODO.md always; AUTOPILOT-LOG.md when resuming or taking over unfinished work; README.md ## Features + docs/tests.md + docs/configuration.md for a feature/bug; docs/architecture.md for architecture; docs/contracts.md BEFORE touching anything another repo consumes; standard/base.md + standard/profiles/<profile>.md to change a rule — never CLAUDE.md, which is generated; skills/*/SKILL.md for a named skill. Update the matching docs in the SAME change (Documentation-sync table) — CI gates doc-sync and standard-drift.'

printf '%s' 'This repo follows CLAUDE.md as a ROUTER over TODO.md, AUTOPILOT-LOG.md, README.md ## Features, docs/{architecture,configuration,tests,contracts}.md, standard/ and skills/. Read its "Start here — context map" before working; working from CLAUDE.md alone is a bug. CLAUDE.md is GENERATED from standard/base.md + standard/profiles/<profile>.md — edit those and run ./standard/compose.sh, never CLAUDE.md itself.'
